localHint: Your workspace stays in this browser. AI requests send selected content to the model provider.
disclaimer: Legal information and preparation, not a substitute for professional advice.
welcome: Make sense of the fine print.
welcomeHint: Read your agreement, understand what deserves attention, and prepare the right questions.
screening: Preliminary keyword screening. A low flag count does not establish that an agreement is safe or enforceable.
error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
aiError: AI could not complete this request. Check the connection, API configuration or quota, then retry.
processing: Selected content is being processed by the AI provider.
title: Document title
uploadHint: PDF or TXT, up to 10 MB. Text is extracted in your browser. Scanned PDFs need OCR; you can use a document image in Ask Nyaya.
emptyDocument: No readable text found. Paste text or use a clear document image in Ask Nyaya.
invalidFile: Choose a PDF or TXT file under 10 MB.
chatHint: Ask about your agreement, add a document image, or speak in your language. Your selected clause stays in context.
message: Ask a question about your agreement…
speechUnavailable: Speech recognition is unavailable for this browser or language. You can type instead.
mediaError: Could not start capture. Check browser permissions and device availability.
voiceHint: Dictation uses your browser's speech service. Review the transcript before sending. Language support depends on the browser.
questionsPrompt: What should I ask a lawyer?
compareHint: Choose a second agreement or paste a revised version. See wording changes locally, then ask AI to explain their meaning.
noChanges: The agreements have the same wording.
intakeHint: Keep facts, dates and evidence together. Only include details you know.
required: Add the other party and a description of what happened.
noEvents: No events yet. Add dates and facts that matter to your case.
draftHint: Review facts and wording before sharing. Nothing is sent automatically.
packHint: Your facts, evidence, timeline and flagged clauses in one print-friendly report.
researchHint: Search for relevant Indian legal information. Open cited sources and verify applicability to your state and facts.
researchQuery: What would you like to research?
noSources: No verified source links were returned. Treat this as an unverified explanation.
navSteps: Gather the agreement and evidence → identify parties and dates → write the facts and requested resolution → check the official portal's requirements → review before submitting.
privacyDetail: Documents, conversations, case details and preferences are stored in this browser. AI features send selected text or images to Google Gemini. Browser dictation may use the browser provider's speech service. Provider retention policies apply. Raw camera, screen and microphone recordings are not saved.
confirmClear: Delete all documents, conversations and case details stored by this app in this browser? This cannot be undone.
storageError: Browser storage is unavailable. Changes may not survive a refresh.
translated: AI translation — original wording remains authoritative
translationHint: Translate the selected clause or ask for an explanation in your chosen language.
printHint: Use your browser's print dialog to save this report as a PDF.
quotaLimit: The provider quota or request limit has been reached. Please retry later.
liveHint: A real-time conversation about your document. You can interrupt at any time.
liveEnded: Conversation ended. Start again to use the current document and language.
liveReady: Five-minute session · camera and screen sharing are optional
livePrivacy: Starting sends selected document context and microphone audio to Google Gemini. Camera or screen frames are sent only when sharing is enabled. Captions stay in this browser; raw audio and video are not saved.
liveLanguageUnavailable: Live speech is not available for this language. Continue using text chat or select another language.
liveExpired: The five-minute session has ended. You can start a new conversation.
liveDisconnected: The live connection ended. Restart to continue; microphone audio was not replayed.
liveUnavailable: Gemini Live is unavailable. Please check model access and quota, or continue in text chat.
aiAuthError: The AI credential is unavailable. The site owner needs to check the server configuration.
groundingUnavailable: Verified search results are unavailable. Please retry later or use the official source links.
aiSafety: The provider could not answer this request. Rephrase your question with the relevant document facts.
